objective: Deliver the accepted packaged-Recovery UTF-8 fix, reusable isolated package acceptance lane, and maintained documentation updates to origin/main. Include the canonical orchestration ledger and generated accepted-wave reports; exclude transient SQLite WAL/SHM sidecars. Do not publish/tag/release the installer.

steps.text: Checkpoint ledger and stage accepted source/evidence

current_step: Checkpoint ledger and stage accepted package-acceptance changes

current_command.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; & git status --short; & python -c \"import sqlite3; p=r'.coding-tools\\orchestration\\ledger.sqlite3'; c=sqlite3.connect(p); print(c.execute('PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(FULL)').fetchall()); c.close()\"; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; & git add -A -- .
